summary: Iteration 8 frontend-only verification at 980x1100. Verified: (1) .cin-backdrop computed style matches spec exactly — backgroundSize '92%', backgroundPosition '50% 27%', backgroundRepeat 'no-repeat', maskImage/webkitMaskImage 'radial-gradient(62% 30% at 50% 32%, rgb(0,0,0) 58%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 92%)', filter 'saturate(1.15) brightness(1.3)'. (2) Rich lock panel renders as expected — visible mp-lock-bg (blurred poster bg), mp-lock-icon (neon lock ring), kicker 'BANBANSPORTS · ORIJINAL YAYIN', film-name subtitle 'Örümcek-Adam: Yepyeni Bir Gün'. ŞİFRE AL → creds head 'ERİŞİM BİLGİLERİ' visible; copy-user-btn → copied-toast shown. Login with lenstedreal_marka/zirvedeyiz closes the lock panel. (3) .fs-card.fs-brands img computed height = 34px. (4) Sponsor banner (GRANDPASHABET) renders, footer/legal render, box-office numbers render without visible truncation, console errors = 0 (only a clipboard writeText permission-denied warning inside sandboxed iframe, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: Test spec references legacy selectors that no longer exist in the DOM (.boxoffice-rate, .boxoffice-gross/local/international, .sponsor-banner, .footer-bottom, .movie-lock-panel as bare classes). Actual DOM uses bo2-* (bo2-bd, bo2-value), sponsors-section/sponsor-item, ft2-legal-body. The visible rendering is correct; consider updating spec selector names or adding stable data-testid attributes to key elements (.cin-backdrop, .cin-card, box-office value rows, sponsor banner, lock panel root, ŞİFRE AL / GİRİŞ YAP buttons) for robust future E2E.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewport MUST be 980x1100 (fixed). Lock panel: click .cin-watch (movie-shelf-watch) to open. Use wildcard/CSS-module-safe selectors like [class*='mp-lock-bg']. Box-office rows use bo2-* prefix, not boxoffice-*. Backdrop CSS asserted directly on .cin-backdrop matches all spec values. Alignment math for backdrop vs bo2-bd rate row was not computable because the spec's .boxoffice-rate selector isn't present, but backdrop CSS values (92% / center 27% / radial mask) are identical to the mathematically correct configuration — placement is deterministic from CSS.
